question_text: Juan was appointed as the executive assistant to the mayor of a city. His appointment is coterminous with the mayor's term. Which of the following best describes a characteristic of a coterminous appointment in a government office?

options.text: The appointee can be removed only for cause and enjoys security of tenure.
The appointment lasts indefinitely and is not affected by the appointing officer's term.
The appointment ends automatically when the appointing officer leaves office.
The appointee must pass a civil service exam to be eligible for the position.
